# The sample's mod lines that read in more than one way (statdesc/testdata/item-lines.txt), with
# the stats each should be read as, written by hand: item | line | stats; the lines of one
# description joined with " / ". Armour and weapons take the local stat where the base rolls it;
# a stat with mods beats a retired or passive-tree one; a unique weapon's armour is global. A
# flask immunity "for 4 seconds" is today's mod with an older roll where that mod can be on the
# flask (life flasks), and the older fixed-duration mod where it cannot (utility flasks). The old
# dagger implicit reads as the stat of the base's implicit today.
